definitions.full: H1690. debelah דְּבֵלָה noun feminine lump of pressed figs, pressed (fig-) cake (Late Hebrew דְּבֵילָה , Aram id. , , = Greek παλάθη ; Arabic lump, large gobbet or mouthful ; compare Assyrian dublu , foundation , & Hebrew synonym אֲשִׁישָׁה Dl HA 58 ) — דְּבֵלָה 1Sam 30:12 ; construct דְּבֶלֶת 2Kin 20:7 = Isa 38:21 ; plural דְּבֵלִים 1Sam 25:18 ; 1Chr 12:40 ; — used as food 1Sam 25:18 ; 30:12 ; 1Chr 12:40 ; תְּאֵנִים דְּבֶלֶת , as application to boil, or eruption 2Kin 20:7 = Isa 38:21 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (akin to 2082 ) probably meaning to press together;

occurrences.englishText: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs* 1 seah is about 7 liters or 1.9 gallons or 0.8 pecks of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.
They gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.
Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.”
Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”
